mapper.select: WITH ORDER_SUM (MEMBER_ID, ORDER_CNT, TOTAL_AMT) AS ( SELECT O.MEMBER_ID, COUNT(*), SUM(O.TOTAL_AMT) FROM TB_ORDER O WHERE O.ORDER_STATUS = '40' AND O.ORDER_DT BETWEEN #{fromDt} AND #{toDt} GROUP BY O.MEMBER_ID ), PAY_SUM AS ( SELECT O.MEMBER_ID, SUM(P.PAY_AMT) AS PAY_AMT FROM TB_PAYMENT P INNER JOIN TB_ORDER O ON O.ORDER_ID = P.ORDER_ID WHERE P.PAY_STATUS = 'DONE' GROUP BY O.MEMBER_ID ) SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.MEMBER_NM, S.ORDER_CNT, S.TOTAL_AMT, COALESCE(PS.PAY_AMT, 0) AS PAY_AMT FROM ORDER_SUM S JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = S.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN PAY_SUM PS ON PS.MEMBER_ID = S.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY S.TOTAL_AMT DESC FETCH FIRST 1000 ROWS ONLY WITH UR

SELECT S.SETTLE_ID, S.SETTLE_YM, S.MEMBER_ID, M.MEMBER_NM, S.ORDER_CNT, S.SETTLE_AMT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY S.SETTLE_AMT DESC) AS RN FROM TB_SETTLE S JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = S.MEMBER_ID WHERE S.SETTLE_YM = #{settleYm} FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY WITH UR

mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SETTLE S SET (S.SETTLE_AMT, S.ORDER_CNT) = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(D.AMT), 0), COUNT(*) FROM TB_SETTLE_DTL D WHERE D.SETTLE_ID = S.SETTLE_ID), S.UPD_TS = CURRENT TIMESTAMP WHERE S.SETTLE_YM = #{settleYm}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_SETTLE_DTL D WHERE D.SETTLE_ID IN (SELECT S.SETTLE_ID FROM TB_SETTLE S WHERE S.SETTLE_YM = #{settleYm})
